data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 蔬菜摊前的认真挑选
data.description: 约尔穿米色束腰风衣与及膝皮靴，在超市低矮的蔬菜架旁屈膝蹲下。购物篮稳放在脚边，她一手拿起一根胡萝卜，另一手轻扶篮柄，歪头仔细检查表皮，红眸认真得像在完成重要任务。木箱里的土豆和卷心菜层层排开，明亮柔和的顶灯照清她的脸。
data.action: 蹲在蔬菜架旁，一手检查胡萝卜，另一手扶住脚边购物篮的提柄。
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, crouching environmental portrait
data.promptProse: Yor crouches beside the supermarket's low vegetable rack, examining a carrot carefully while her other hand steadies the shopping-basket handle beside her boots. Her belted beige trench coat stays closed over a neat outfit in the three-quarter medium view. Wooden crates of potatoes and cabbages form rows behind her. Soft overhead store light illuminates her concentrated face and the carrot skin, with close basket shadows on the floor.
